untimed_retention.note: Untimed interpreter native process. Manual cache clear only; production code unchanged. Pool-0 delta includes the retained snapshot object.
untimed_retention.probe_source:
# frozen_string_literal: true
require File.join(ENV.fetch("LOWRAIL_ROOT"), "config/application")
Rails.application.config.yjit = false
require File.join(ENV.fetch("LOWRAIL_ROOT"), "config/environment")
require "rack/mock"
require "objspace"
require "json"
Rails.logger.level = :error
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = nil
session = Rack::MockRequest.new(Rails.application)
request = -> do
  response = session.get("/articles/1", "HTTP_HOST" => "localhost", "HTTPS" => "on")
  raise "HTTP #{response.status}" unless response.status == 200
end
50.times { request.call }
raise "form inactive" unless Lowrail::Stats.unit_hits.fetch("18") == 50 && Lowrail::Stats.unit_fallbacks.empty?
inventory = Lowrail::FormScaffoldInventory
snapshot = -> do
  3.times { GC.start(full_mark: true, immediate_sweep: true) }
  {compiled_files: inventory.instance_variable_get(:@compiled).size,
   iseq_wrappers: ObjectSpace.each_object(RubyVM::InstructionSequence).count,
   pool0_live_slots: GC.stat_heap(0).fetch(:heap_live_slots)}
end
snapshot.call # Warm the diagnostic itself before the retained before/after.
before = snapshot.call
inventory.instance_variable_get(:@compiled).clear
after = snapshot.call
Lowrail::Stats.reset_counts!
50.times { request.call }
hits = Lowrail::Stats.unit_hits.fetch("18")
fallbacks = Lowrail::Stats.unit_fallbacks.fetch("18", 0)
raise "post-clear form failed" unless hits == 50 && fallbacks.zero?
epoch = Lowrail::FormScaffold.instance_variable_get(:@epoch)
epoch[0] = 1
request.call
raise "epoch refusal bypassed" unless Lowrail::Stats.unit_fallbacks.fetch("18") == 1
puts JSON.generate({diagnostic_only: true, mode: Lowrail.jit_status, before: before, after: after,
  post_clear_requests: 50, post_clear_hits: hits, post_clear_fallbacks: fallbacks,
  forced_epoch_fallbacks: Lowrail::Stats.unit_fallbacks.fetch("18"),
  refusal: Lowrail::FormScaffold.refusal,
  compiled_files_after_requests: inventory.instance_variable_get(:@compiled).size,
  note: "Untimed interpreter native process. Manual cache clear only; production code unchanged. Pool-0 delta includes the retained snapshot object."})
